Privacy notice.

This notice explains how information submitted through the CyWareGroups website is handled.

Information you provide

When you contact CyWareGroups, you may provide your name, work email, company, timeline, service interests, and the contents of your message. Please do not submit passwords, credentials, or unnecessary sensitive information.

How information is used

Information is used to respond to enquiries, understand requested services, prepare a possible engagement, maintain business correspondence, and protect the website and communications from misuse.

Enquiry form

The current website prepares an email in your device’s email application. The website does not independently store the form submission. Your email provider’s privacy terms apply when you send the message.

Sharing

Information should only be shared with service providers or professional advisers when needed to operate the business, respond to the enquiry, comply with law, or protect legitimate interests. CyWareGroups does not state that it sells personal information.

Retention and security

Business correspondence should be retained only as long as needed for the purpose collected, legal obligations, dispute resolution, and security. No transmission or storage method can be guaranteed completely secure.

Your choices

You may request access, correction, or deletion of information in a prior enquiry by emailing hello@cywaregroups.com. Rights vary by location and applicable law.

Contact

Questions about this notice can be sent to hello@cywaregroups.com.

This is a practical starter privacy notice and is not legal advice. Review it with qualified counsel before a public commercial launch.
